title: Remove Superhuman: revoke Google access + cancel subscription (needs David signed in)
body:
David moved to plain Gmail (2026-10-21). Superhuman's 12 Gmail labels were already deleted (messages untouched); nothing was snoozed or muted.

Needs David (user@example.com is signed out in his Chrome; sign-in uses his passkey):
1. Revoke Superhuman's access at https://myaccount.google.com/connections, or sign in to user@example.com in Chrome, unblock this card, and the agent will do it.
2. Cancel the Superhuman subscription (billing, his call) in Superhuman → Settings → Billing.
3. Gmail inbox tabs: Settings → Inbox → Inbox type "Default" (Primary/Promotions/Updates/Social). The API can't set this; the agent can do it in Chrome once he's signed in.

Done when: Superhuman is gone from the connections page, the subscription is cancelled, and the Gmail tabs show. Context: ~/code/hermes/docs/polspam.md

title: polspam: add Email Routing permission to cf-example-infra token, then create user@example.com
body:
Plan step: a throwaway alias user@example.com for future political donations and petitions, so any list that sells the address can be shut off.

Blocked: the token-broker scope `user/cf-example-infra` returns "Authentication error" on GET /zones/<example.org>/email/routing/rules. David needs to add **Zone → Email Routing Rules: Edit** (plus Account → Email Routing Addresses: Read) for example.org to that Cloudflare API token (dash.cloudflare.com → My Profile → API Tokens), then unblock this card.

After unblock, the agent will:
1. Create a routing rule: user@example.com → forward to user@example.com (check that the destination is verified).
2. In ~/.hermes/bin/polspam, treat mail addressed to user@example.com as political even when it isn't bulk mail (still respecting the allowlist), deploy it to the mini (~/.bb-hermes/bin/polspam), and send a test email.
3. Update ~/code/hermes/docs/polspam.md.
